title: Customer network remediation docket authoring tool for private/VPC/on-prem intake
creator: Priya Khatri
description: Create a tool that ingests customer intake data and network probe results and produces a tailored, actionable 'remediation docket' for Private/VPC/on-prem requests. The docket should enumerate exact network changes, firewall/port rules, proxy configurations, and upgrade sequencing recommendations in a format both customers and SRE/Support can execute. Aim to reduce manual back-and-forth during triage and shorten time-to-onboard for network-constrained customers.
background: We receive many Private/VPC/on-prem requests that stall on ambiguous or incomplete network requirements. Current triage requires multiple meetings and bespoke docs. This ticket proposes a semi-automated authoring tool that converts intake answers + network-probe output into a prescriptive remediation plan with estimated effort, validation checks, and rollback steps. This complements the network-probe library work and reduces repeat engineering time spent drafting custom runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Produces a remediation docket PDF and a machine-readable JSON summary given a) intake form, and b) network probe output (format defined by ENG-89232)

Docket sections include: executive summary, required firewall/port rules (CIDR/ports/protocols), proxy/egress rules, TLS/KMS handshake notes, routing and NAT expectations, sample iptables/ACL snippets, sequencing for upgrades and rollback steps, and a validation checklist
Docket includes confidence level (low/medium/high) and an estimated engineering effort (hours) to remediate
Generated docket stored in customer support ticket (Zendesk/GH issue) and linked in Console onboarding UI
Customer-facing language and an engineer-facing checklist are both present; PM/Design sign-off on language
Automated checks detect major incompatibilities and flag as ‘requires architecture review’
End-to-end test: run against 3 synthetic network profiles (strict air-gapped, corporate proxy w/ egress whitelist, hybrid NAT) and verify generated outputs match expected templates
implementation_notes: Backend service (remediation-author) that takes intake form + probe JSON and maps to template rules
Leverage existing network-probe output schema (ENG-89232). If schema gaps found, create adapter with ENG team.
Templates managed in a lightweight templating store (git-backed); allow overrides per account tier
Expose an internal-only API first; surface in Console as 'Draft remediation plan' UI in onboarding lane
Provide a 'publish' action that attaches the PDF + JSON summary to the customer's Support ticket and marks the intake as 'Remediation Proposed'
CLI helper for Solutions Engineers to run local probes and generate dockets during calls
Track telemetry: time-to-first-docket, docket acceptance by customer, number of follow-up network clarifications
Privacy: redact IPs in stored example snippets for docs; full details only in customer-facing exports and support ticket attachments
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Incorrect automated recommendations could lead to failed onboarding — Mitigation: include explicit confidence and require engineering approval for low-confidence dockets
Risk: Template drift across cloud vendors — Mitigation: maintain provider-specific fragments and validate during template CI
Risk: Sensitive information exposure — Mitigation: limit storage of full dockets to support ticket attachments, redact in knowledge base copies
Risk: Over-reliance by customers — Mitigation: label as 'recommended plan' and include manual validation checklist for customers and SREs
tasks: PM: Draft initial intake-to-docket mapping spec and examples (link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PD/Remediation+Docket+Spec)
Eng: Prototype remediation-author microservice and adapter for network-probe schema (ENG-89232)
Design: Create customer-friendly and engineer checklist templates; get legal review for wording
Eng: Add 'publish to support ticket' integration (Zendesk/GH) and Console surface
SRE: Define validation test cases for strict air-gapped, corporate-proxy, hybrid scenarios
Solutions Eng: Pilot with 4 real customer intakes and gather feedback
PM: Prepare rollout comms and update intake playbook
